method: Four parallel search agents (two candidates each) using WebSearch (Google-mediated) plus WebFetch of arXiv, PMC, Europe PMC REST, NCBI E-utilities (esummary/efetch), Frontiers, Springer, colab.ws. PubMed article pages and AHA/AJNR/Wiley/IEEE pages were cookie-walled or 403; PMID verification went through NCBI E-utilities.
search_limits: 2025-2026 MICCAI/ISLES post-challenge workshop proceedings sparsely indexed and not enumerated individually

arXiv:2505.18424 read at abstract level; a buried interpretability appendix cannot be fully excluded
Amador ISBI 2024 (C6) methods not inspectable beyond abstract; supplementary curve-shape perturbations cannot be ruled out

neighbors.establishing_passage: 'a carefully designed preprocessing pipeline including deep-learning-based skull stripping and custom intensity windowing is beneficial for accurate segmentation' — abstract contains no interpretability or feature-use analysis; the windowing claim is performance-based (CV Dice deltas), not a representation audit.

neighbors.identifier: PMID 35357053 (Cao Z et al., Hum Brain Mapp 2022; sibling PMID 30498017, Kuang H et al., AJNR 2019)
neighbors.establishing_passage: E-utilities confirms title/venue; DLAD/ASPECTS literature is framed entirely as scoring/detection ('sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy of DLAD for the prediction of ASPECTS were 65%, 82%, and 80%'), not model-use auditing.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2312.12865 (RadEdit, ECCV 2024)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Uses generative editing to 'simulate dataset shifts and diagnose failure modes of biomedical vision models'; chest X-ray only — no stroke, CT, or gray-white-contrast concept.

neighbors.identifier: PMID 18811738 (Puetz V et al., Int J Stroke 2008)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'Quantification of intracranial thrombus extent with the clot burden score predicts functional outcome, final infarct size and parenchymal hematoma risk acutely.'

neighbors.identifier: Tan IYL et al., 'CT Angiography Clot Burden Score and Collateral Score: Correlation with Clinical and Radiologic Outcomes in Acute Middle Cerebral Artery Infarct', AJNR 2009;30:525
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'Baseline ASPECTS, CBS, CBV, and collateral score were associated with final infarct size on multivariate linear regression analysis.'

neighbors.identifier: 'Thrombus Imaging Features for Anterior Circulation Stroke: Their Impact on CTP Parameters and Natural Evolution of Infarct Progression', J Pers Med 2025 (PMC12565474)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'Higher CBS values and shorter thrombi are associated with a reduced ischemic core... diminished hypoperfused tissue... and smaller penumbra volume'; methods are univariable/multivariable regression only — no ML, no audits, no counterfactual editing.

neighbors.identifier: PMID 39788631 (AJNR 2025, CoW variants and outcome after successful revascularization)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'Multivariable logistic regression analysis demonstrated a significant association between I-CoW and 90-day mRS compared with NI-CoW... I-CoW anatomy was associated with a higher 90-day mortality.'

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2312.17670 / PMID 38235066 (TopCoW challenge)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'The benchmark includes voxel-level segmentation, CoW component detection, CoW variant classification, and two clinical application tasks'; variant graph 'converted from the CoW segmentation mask... identified by a four-edge graph.'

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1002/cnm.70121 (Mut et al., Int J Numer Methods Biomed Eng 2025)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'The framework integrates systemic hemodynamics, medical-image-based cerebral vascular reconstruction, and cerebral autoregulation functionality to assess the collateral capacity of the Circle of Willis under anatomical variations and progressive stenosis.' (Wiley fetch 403.)

neighbors.identifier: PMID 21566009 / DOI 10.3174/ajnr.A2504 (Black DF et al., AJNR 2011)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'A statistically significant correlation between HGB and HCT values with HUs was found for both men and women... hemoconcentration may cause CT attenuation to appear as if patients have thrombosis when they in fact do not.' (PMC7966032.)

neighbors.identifier: PMID 34507404 (Neurology India 2021)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'Objective attenuation values of dural sinuses on plain CT can be positively correlated with Hb and HCT values. Considering the cutoff of 35.5 HU, we were able to show the specificity of 100% for the detection of anemia.'

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2509.08640 (RoentMod, 2025)
neighbors.establishing_passage: RoentMod 'combines an open-source medical image generator (RoentGen) with an image-to-image modification model without requiring retraining'; counterfactual images 'improved model discrimination across multiple pathologies by 3-19% AUC.'

neighbors.identifier: PMID 25931460 / DOI 10.1161/STROKEAHA.115.009304 (Haussen DC et al., Stroke 2015)
neighbors.establishing_passage: ISE present in 8/108 patients (7.4%); imaging showed 'engorged/dilated leptomeningeal vessels'; 'Follow-up imaging confirmed no infarct in the ISE area in all patients'; 'ISE should not be used to exclude patients from thrombectomy.' (Full abstract via E-utilities.)

neighbors.identifier: PMID 32912520 (J Stroke Cerebrovasc Dis 2020)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'ISE was observed in 12 patients (6.2% of all...) corresponding to excellent specificity (100%) but fair sensitivity (12%) for diagnosis of anterior cerebral circulation proximal artery occlusion.'

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1007/978-3-031-79103-1_19 (Taba Chabi et al., Springer 2025)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'integrating GLCM and SVM improves the accuracy of sulcal effacement segmentation by up to 81%' — detection of effacement as a stroke sign; no collateral/survival direction, no model audit.

'The results of the attention analysis revealed that the model effectively focuses on two specific temporal patterns associated with observed variations in contrast concentration dynamics.' Correlational attention analysis on a raw-4D-CTP outcome model; abstract-level access only (IEEE page empty; partial via colab.ws).

neighbors.identifier: PMID 29500248 (Lin L et al., Stroke 2018)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'Delay and dispersion correction increases the accuracy of ischemic core measurement on CTP.' (Via E-utilities.)

neighbors.identifier: PMID 40194529 / DOI 10.1088/2057-1976/adc9b6 (Zeng W et al., Biomed Phys Eng Express 2025)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'The proposed method is capable of estimating local AIF and perfusion parameters with high accuracy... in the presence of noise, delay, dispersion, temporal resolution, and bolus shape' — dispersion as nuisance correction/augmentation, not audit.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2403.06748 (Shortcut Learning in Medical Image Segmentation, MICCAI 2024)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'Clinical annotations such as calipers, and the combination of zero-padded convolutions and center-cropped training sets in the dataset can inadvertently serve as shortcuts'; padding lets a CNN 'encode — in a band around the image border — the distance to the image border.'

neighbors.identifier: PMID 41583397 / DOI 10.1161/SVIN.124.001375 (Werdiger F et al., SVIN 2024)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Attention U-Net final-infarct-core model 'outperformed the current clinical standard, providing a more accurate core estimate than single-threshold-based measures.' PMID explicitly verified real via esummary/efetch despite its unusual number.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.3389/fneur.2026.1794563 (Frontiers Neurol 2026, territorial infarct ML)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'segmentation logic strictly aligned with the Talairach and Tournoux brain atlas (the gold standard for cerebral arterial perfusion territory division)'; paper does not audit whether the network uses distance-to-territory-border.

neighbors.identifier: PMID 35373655 (Kauw F et al., Int J Stroke 2022/23, PMC9896253)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'Adding the CSF/ICV ratio improves a multimodal prediction model for the occurrence of malignant edema after endovascular treatment'; OR 1.2 per point decrease, p<0.001; no final-infarct segmentation audited.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1007/s12028-021-01325-x (Foroushani et al., Neurocrit Care 2021/22, PMC8858326)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Explainable LSTM with automated CSF volumes and an 'intracranial reserve' feature; 'The hemispheric CSF ratio and NIHSS at 24-hours had the greatest contributions to shifting the predicted probability of malignant edema' (SHAP) — edema endpoint, not final-infarct mask geometry.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1097/RLI.0000000000000475 (Invest Radiol 2018, subacute infarct volume with edema correction)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'early follow-up imaging volumes are significantly impaired by ischemic edema, which causes overestimation of the true lesion volume... allowing the final lesion volume to be better estimated by correcting... for the corresponding proportion of edema.'
